title: 赤とんぼ (Aka Tonbo — Red Dragonfly)
description: One of Japan's most beloved songs: a nostalgic image of red dragonflies at sunset carrying the singer back to childhood — being carried on someone's back, picking mulberries in the mountain field, a young nursemaid who left for marriage at fifteen. Words by 三木露風 (Miki Rofu, 1921), music by 山田耕筰 (Yamada Kōsaku, 1927).
license: Public Domain (lyrics: 三木露風 d. 1964, music: 山田耕筰 d. 1965 — both entered PD in Japan by 2016 under 50-year rule in force at the time of expiry)
